description: This file implements a handler for managing contacts on an Android device, including searching and adding contacts via the Contacts Content Provider, with permission checks and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact's details including name, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search parameters for contacts query.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating contact details for adding a new contact.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for contacts data management, including permission checks, search, and add actions.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing ContactsDataSource, interacting with Android's Contacts Provider to perform search and add operations with permission enforcement.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Handles the contact search request, verifying permissions, parsing parameters, and returning matching contacts as JSON.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Handles the request to add a new contact, validating permissions, parsing parameters, and returning the added contact.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a ContactsSearchRequest object with query and limit.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a ContactsAddRequest object with contact info.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Converts a ContactRecord into a JSON object for serialization.
